meta.experiment: E1 -- FPR vs benign fragment rate (operating boundary)
meta.fidelity_note: Imports the real shannon_entropy + r2_should_block from resolver.py; sliding window mirrors R2EntropyTable._prune; IPID model from auth_server.py. Controlled-emulation testbed (no Docker / real IP fragmentation).

detectors.legacy: Rℓ2 gốc (paper POPS, Algorithm 3): chặn mọi fragment
detectors.combined: Rℓ2 cải tiến của nhóm: samples>=24 AND entropy>=4.0 AND unique_ratio>=0.70

behaviors.smallpool16: Small IPID pool (uniform 0..15) -- NAT / constrained host

meta.fpr_definition: false positives = benign tc_block; FPR = blocks / decisions
meta.system_metrics_scope: Detector latency/throughput/CPU/memory are not estimable from this virtual-time simulation; Docker low-load fidelity is reported separately.

event_level_raw.layout: one JSONL file per independent run under raw_decisions/{phase}/{behavior}/level_{level}/
event_level_raw.raw_scope: one record for every scored decision after warmup; overlapping window contents are represented by samples/unique/entropy, not duplicated IPID arrays
